set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set security nat source pool [parameter1.command: set security nat source pool nat1
set security nat source pool [parameter1.explanation: This command configures a source NAT pool named `[parameter1]` in Junos, defining a range of IP addresses used for translating private source IPs to public IPs.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Name of NAT source pool.

address [parameter2]/[parameter3].explanation: The command assigns an IP address (`[parameter2]`) with a subnet mask (`[parameter3]`) to a network interface in Junos OS.

parameters.name: start-address
parameters.explanation: The starting address of the NAT source address pool.

parameters.name: start-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of subnet mask bits for the starting address.

to [parameter4]/[parameter5].explanation: The command `to [parameter4]/[parameter5]` specifies the destination interface or unit in Junos, where `[parameter4]` is the interface name and `[parameter5]` is the unit number.

parameters.name: end-address
parameters.explanation: The end address of the NAT source address pool.

parameters.name: end-mask
parameters.explanation: The number of subnet mask bits for the end address.

set security nat source rule-set [parame.command: set security nat source rule-set source-nat-rules
set security nat source rule-set [parame.explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule set in Junos, defining a collection of rules for translating source IP addresses in traffic matching specified criteria.

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT rule book.

from zone [parameter2].explanation: Configure the source safety area for the NAT ruleset application.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.explanation: Name of the source security area.

to zone [parameter2].explanation: Configure the purpose safe area for the NAT ruleset application.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.explanation: The name of the destination security area.

rule [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a source NAT rule within a specified rule-set, defining how traffic matching the rule is translated before leaving the network.

parameters.name: rule-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the NAT rule.

match source-address [parameter3]/[param.explanation: Configures the source address that the NAT rules match.

parameters.name: source-address
parameters.explanation: Matches the source address.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: _Other Organiser

then source-nat pool [parameter3].explanation: Configures the address pool that you want to use for the NAT conversion.

parameters.name: pool-name
parameters.explanation: Name of the address pool used for the source NAT conversion.

set firewall family inet filter [paramet.command: set firewall family inet filter acl-2001
set firewall family inet filter [paramet.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.explanation: Firewall filter name.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: Filter term name.

from source-address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configures the source address conditions for access to the control list.

parameters.name: source-address
parameters.explanation: Source IP address.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Number of subnet masks in source IP address.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

family inet filter input [parameter3].explanation: Configure the input filter for the interface.

parameters.name: filter-name
parameters.explanation: Filter name.
